name: How can a duplex renovation increase property value or rental income?

mainEntity.name: How can a duplex renovation increase property value or rental income?

acceptedAnswer.text: A well-executed duplex renovation can significantly increase property value and rental income by modernizing outdated spaces, improving functionality, and enhancing curb appeal. Updated kitchens and bathrooms, energy-efficient upgrades, fresh paint, and new flooring are highly attractive to prospective tenants and buyers, justifying higher rents or a better sale price. Renovations can also convert underutilized spaces into additional bedrooms or living areas, further boosting profitability and market desirability in competitive areas like Las Vegas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Duplex renovations increase property value and rental income by modernizing spaces, improving functionality, and enhancing appeal through updates like kitchens, bathrooms, and energy-efficient features.
